pilares.descripcion: Diagnosis, conversation and planning before any procedure.
Respect for tooth structure. Every intervention has a biological cost that must be explained.
The patient must understand their case. Educate without infantilizing, speak clearly without emptying.
The mouth belongs to someone. Deep humanity without sentimentality.
A confident professional doesn't need to do everything. Rehabilitation requires integrating specialties.

adn.manifiestoPublico: I'm Dr. Gaby. I've been a dentist for two decades. It's not about grabbing the drill — it's about sitting down, listening to you, and building a treatment plan together that makes sense, that you understand, and that fits your needs. My work isn't to sell you a treatment. It's to help you understand your case so you can decide with confidence. I listen.

disclaimers.consultaNoPromete: The Diagnostic & Planning Consultation does NOT promise: a definitive diagnosis without the necessary studies, a closed quote by WhatsApp, a perfect aesthetic solution, or immediate treatment without planning.
disclaimers.fotoNoAlcanza: A photo is not enough to diagnose with seriousness. I can orient you, but to tell you what's best I need to evaluate you clinically.
disclaimers.noCompitePorPrecio: My approach doesn't compete on price. It competes on judgment. If you're looking for the lowest price, there are other options. If you're looking to understand your case, you're in the right place.
